posts.title: SFX electronics: LED skin prosthetic Plan B
posts.description: The best laid plans of mice and men… Extremely tight deadlines for pre-production mean there’s no time to fab+assembly (given that a revision to first fabs might be needed), so time for plan B: a much simpler push-button wired solution, no MCU etc. But first a summary of where I got to with the PCB.
